system.description:
Use your Astral Form to possess a living or dead enemy or ally. Conscious target: Opposed Strange vs its Smarts; on a win you control its actions and have all its abilities and attributes, and on each of its Combat Turns it repeats the contest, forcing you out if it wins. Dead enemy: CR 1 Strange Check; it returns with half its Health Points as your puppet. Doom +4.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.68

automation.label: Conscious target: opposed vs its Smarts
automation.onSuccess: You possess the target and control its actions, abilities and attributes.

automation.label: Dead enemy
automation.onSuccess: It rises with half its Health Points as your puppet.

automation.note: Requires Astral Form. Conscious target: the Director rolls its Smarts and sets the CR so you need more successes; it repeats the contest on each of its Combat Turns and throws you out if it wins.
